messages:
omar: Quicknote from running the Go quickstart: immediate 429s when the onboarding credits hit and the sample spawns the warmup batch. Happens even with small datasets.

hannah: can you paste the log snippet? Hosted or Dedicated?

omar: Hosted. log:
[2024-08-03T14:12:10Z] WARN req=zzx status=429 Retry-After=1
[2024-08-03T14:12:10Z] DEBUG prefill=start spawn=20 inflight=30

yu: Looks like prefill+no-jitter. FYI our Go SDK default prefill=20 while JS/Python samples use lower numbers. parity issue again.

hannah: this is bad UX for new orgs. proposal: reduce sampleapp warmup defaults to prefill=6, maxInflight=8 for Hosted; add env SAMPLEAPP_WARMUP_MAX to override.

omar: also add small client helper in Go: SafeWarmup(ctx, client, opts) that limits concurrency and respects Retry-After headers with full jitter.

yu: agree. also tweak pagination sample: don't prefetch more than 1 page by default; show streaming pattern to apply backpressure.

omar: I'll open a quick PR that changes Go sample defaults + adds a note in quickstart. will include a tiny smoke e2e that asserts inflight <= 10 during warmup.

ci-bot: pipeline `quickstart/go-warmup-fix` queued for branch `devex/go-warmup-safe`

hannah: thanks. we should also add a short "Avoid warmup thundering-herds" blurb in the SDK DX guide and link the helper.

yu: created GH issue for parity + helper: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/812 (labels: dx, sdk-parity).

omar: rerunning onboarding on staging after PR lands and will post results here.
